design_rationale:
WORKLOG — air_ticketing_desk, task 0 (round 1).

STEP 0 — DRAW, LEDGER, SCOPE CLAIM.
draw_counts.py env/online_travel_agency/tasks/air_ticketing_desk --tasks 2 printed:
  {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4, 5]}
  {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}
This task is therefore a tree of four problems (root plus three prerequisites) and the factor counts
over its four computations must be the multiset {4, 5, 5, 5}. Assignment chosen: the no-show penalty
takes 4, and the tax return, the voucher and the release take 5 each. Nothing was designed before the
draw was read, and the draw was never adjusted to the design.

Occupied before this task: nothing; this is the first task of the difficulty. Claimed here: the four
extended policies air_ext_no_show_penalty, air_ext_unflown_tax_return, air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit
and air_ext_credit_release, with their four task tools. Left free for task 1 (which the draw gives two
problems): the ticketing side of the charter — air_ticketing and air_service_fee on what is collected
when a held booking is ticketed, air_club_benefit_interaction and air_biz_exclusion on how a club tier
and a corporate programme change that collection. Task 1 therefore has an independent root (the money
collected to complete a hold) and an independent prerequisite (the agency service line that must stand
before the balance can be worked out), touching none of the cancellation, penalty, credit or redemption
ground claimed here.

Design thesis. Surface goal: a traveller who missed her August flights and cancelled the rest wants the
value of that trip put towards a November booking she is holding. Scored core: the sum taken off her own
voucher. Between the two lie three problems she never mentions — the no-show penalty owed on the ticket,
the carrier-imposed taxes owed back to her card, and the voucher itself, which cannot be valued until
both of those stand on the ledger. Depth: goal -> release -> voucher -> {penalty, tax return}, three
hops, whose order the prerequisite sentences state. Breadth: at each hop the number turns on the fare
brand's own parameters, on a stretch of that booking's ledger (base fares, tax lines, an old change fee,
three airline notices, the optional extras), on the traveller's club tier and points ledger in another
difficulty's product, and on the travel protection policy bought against this very booking in a third.

STEP 0 — BASE-INVARIANT CARD (rewritten in round 3; every base policy in every lineage is listed with
what it supersedes and what it still governs, so the card and `overwrite` say the same thing).

air_penalty (subject air_penalty_charge, governing) carries no structured eligibility, so its scope is
inherited as policy_scope. Superseded, declared in air_ext_no_show_penalty.overwrite: "the no-show
penalty of the fare brand held is withheld from whatever value the ticket still carries" (the extended
policy multiplies the brand figure by the travellers counted and the share withheld, and takes the
rework offset off the product) and "Where the value still on the ticket is smaller than the penalty, the
penalty is limited to that value and no balance is pursued." (the ceiling is the booking's own fare and
optional-extra lines, not its net paid total). Still in force and honoured: a cancellation penalty and a
no-show penalty are never both withheld against one ticket — this task raises a no-show penalty only and
no cancellation-penalty line stands; a penalty is never withheld where the airline did not operate the
flight — the notices here are schedule moves below the brand's threshold, not cancellations; and the
infant share and the child discount are applied before the penalty is measured, which is exactly what
the fare-weighted traveller count makes executable.
air_club_benefit_interaction (subject air_fare_charge, air_ancillary_charge — not governing here; carried
as input lineage by all four of this task's policies, because all four turn a club tier into money).
Superseded: "the fare brand's own rates apply to everything the club does not cover", declared by
air_ext_no_show_penalty (the tier softens the penalty) and by air_ext_unflown_tax_return (the tier waives
the handling charge); and "A club benefit and a fare-brand inclusion never stack into a payment to the
traveller: a bag already included in the brand is simply free, and the club benefit is not converted into
value.", declared by air_ext_unflown_tax_return, air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit (the uplift) and
air_ext_credit_release (the reissue treatment). Still in force: the tier that counts is the one held on
the ticket issue date, and club points accrue on the base fare only — neither is touched here.
air_refund_settlement (subject air_refund_payout, governing) carries refund_stage_reached, a state gate:
"A payout line is raised only while the booking record stands at cancelled, refund pending or refunded."
Authoritative evidence: air_bookings.status, correlated by air_bookings.air_booking_id, which the tool
takes as its air_booking_id argument. On this world the booking stands cancelled, so it holds; had it
still stood ticketed the correct terminal state would be no payout at all. Superseded, declared in
air_ext_unflown_tax_return.overwrite: the per-line clause ("Each payout line is raised against the
original fare line it reverses…") and the single-form clause ("A lodged claim settles in the form the
fare brand prescribes and in no other form: money to the card, or value on a voucher, never both and
never a mixture"). Neither quotation is the gate's condition, so the gate is untouched and still carried
in base_preconditions. Still in force: a payout may never exceed what the original line collected, and a
claim the airline declines is closed with no payout.
air_price_drop_guarantee (subject air_refund_payout, governing) carries no eligibility and is inherited
as policy_scope with nothing superseded; its one settlement per booking is untouched because this write
is not a price-drop settlement.
air_credit_validity (subject air_credit_issue, governing for the voucher; carried as input lineage by
air_ext_credit_release as well) carries cancelled_before_issue, the same shape of state gate, satisfied
by the same cancelled status. Superseded: "A travel credit is issued for the value the cancelled ticket
still carried after any penalty has been withheld, and carries an expiry set by the credit validity term
of the fare brand that produced it.", declared by air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit, whose ordered subtotal
takes more off than the penalty alone; and "A voucher that has lapsed may be reissued once onto a fresh
voucher against the brand's reissue fee, and the fresh voucher carries the same validity term counted
from the day of reissue.", declared by air_ext_credit_release, which takes that fee off every release.
Still in force and honoured: the voucher is issued in the name of the traveller the ticket was issued to;
a brand whose credit validity term is zero issues no voucher at all (Economy Classic's is twelve); and
the expiry is set by that term, which is what fixes voucher_expires_on at 2027-09-16.
air_agg_credit_pooling (subject air_credit_redeem, governing) carries credit_still_valid, a time gate.
Starting business event: the moment the voucher was issued against the traveller's cancelled booking.
Authoritative anchor: air_booking_events.posted_at. Duration: variants.credit_validity_months, twelve
for Economy Classic. Counting: whole calendar months from the voucher issue date, the last day of the
month standing in where the issue day does not exist. Direction: not_after. Boundary: inclusive.
Positive case: the voucher is raised at 2026-09-16 10:42:00 CDT and frozen time is that same moment, so
frozen time is not after issue plus twelve months (2027-09-16) by a clear year. Negative case: a voucher
raised on 2025-09-15 would have lapsed on 2026-09-15, one day before the handling date, and the correct
answer would be to reissue rather than to spend. Both are recorded in temporal_feasibility.boundary_check.
Superseded, declared in air_ext_credit_release.overwrite: the one-pool sentence and both itinerary-price
sentences. None of the three is the gate's condition, so credit_still_valid is untouched and still
carried in base_preconditions. Still in force: vouchers are consumed soonest-to-lapse first, the expiry
is never extended by redemption, and a voucher is redeemable only by the traveller it was issued to
unless the producing brand makes credits transferable — Economy Classic does not, and the traveller is
redeeming her own.
No other base policy's subject intersects these four writes, so check_solvability's required lineage is
exactly {air_penalty}, {air_refund_settlement, air_price_drop_guarantee}, {air_credit_validity},
{air_agg_credit_pooling}; the two extra lineage entries (air_club_benefit_interaction on all four,
air_credit_validity on the release) are declared for citation and override and add no precondition.

STEP 0 — BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD.
The narrowest object is the single air booking QK7PLM, the Chicago-to-Lisbon trip departing 2026-08-24,
identified by its own air_booking_id, which every one of the four writes carries as its correlation key.
Rows that enter the aggregates: the three base-fare lines (fare-weighted travellers and the ceiling), the
three tax lines (the taxes in question), the three service lines (the service deduction), the three
optional-extra lines (the extras carried and the ceiling), the one voluntary change line (the rework
offset) and the three airline notices (the disruption relief). Rows excluded and why: the April notice
lies outside the three-month window the relief is read over; the second, forty-five-minute notice is
disregarded in favour of the largest single move; the declined baggage claim on the protection policy
pays nothing and so does not move the insured share; the qualifying accrual of 2025-08-30 falls twelve
whole months back and is outside the twelve-month window. The November booking RB4TQZ shares the
traveller but no ledger at all: it carries no money line, so it can never be confused with the object the
first three writes act on, and it is named only as the itinerary the redemption is applied to. Nothing on
this booking has been settled before: no penalty, no payout, no voucher and no redemption line exists at
the opening, which is exactly what makes the three prerequisites unmet.

STEP 0 — PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: air_ext_credit_release (the traveller's own write, owner=user). Prerequisites:
  air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit <- air_ext_no_show_penalty   kind value_input, gate penalty_lines
  air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit <- air_ext_unflown_tax_return kind value_input, gate payout_lines
  air_ext_credit_release <- air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit     kind value_input, gate standing_credit
Three prerequisite problems, matching the draw; three value_input edges against a floor of max(3-1,1)=2.
Every prerequisite sentence is in the state form; no fallback was needed, and none carries a
fallback_reason.
  (1) "The value placed on a travel credit voucher is settled only after the booking's ledger carries the
      penalty entry owed for every traveller recorded as not having flown, and that entry is taken off the
      fare, tax and service lines standing on the booking."
      Four-point test: it joins this policy's own result (the value placed on a voucher) to what it waits
      on with the ordering connective "only after"; the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a
      penalty entry standing on the booking's ledger, named in the words the ledger and the finders use;
      it names no tool, no policy id and no code token; and its strength is exactly the edge's — a hard
      "only after", scoped to the penalty entry owed for travellers recorded as not having flown, no wider
      and no narrower than the condition. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about:
      air_ext_no_show_penalty is the only policy whose subject is air_penalty_charge, so its target tool
      is the only one that puts a penalty entry on a booking. Derivation: the sentence says a penalty
      entry must stand; the records show the booking's net paid total is the sum of sixteen lines, none of
      them a penalty; the penalty policy's own rule says what a no-show penalty is and that it is
      withheld; therefore the reader must first have that penalty withheld. One reading only.
  (2) "Before that value is worked out the booking's ledger must already carry the payout entry owed for
      the carrier-imposed taxes on an unflown ticket, and whatever that entry has returned to the form of
      payment used is taken off as well."
      Four-point test: ordering connective "Before"; the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a
      payout entry standing on the ledger; no tool, id or code token; and its scope is exactly the
      carrier-imposed taxes on an unflown ticket, which is the edge's condition. Exactly one write brings
      it about: air_ext_unflown_tax_return is the only policy whose subject is air_refund_payout.
  (3) "Value is taken off a traveller's credit only once a voucher carrying that value stands on the
      booking whose cancellation produced it."
      Four-point test: ordering connective "only once"; the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a
      voucher standing on the cancelled booking; no tool, id or code token; and it is a hard requirement
      scoped to a voucher raised against that booking. Exactly one write brings it about:
      air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit is the only policy whose subject is air_credit_issue.
Seed evidence that each is false at the opening is recorded row by row in prerequisite_closure.edges;
in short, initial_state.air_bookings.<QK7PLM>.amount_paid_usd = 2364.45 is exactly the sum of the sixteen
seeded lines, of which none is a penalty line and none a payout line, and
initial_state.air_bookings.<QK7PLM>.credit_balance_usd = 0.0 with no credit-issue line anywhere.
Topological order: penalty, tax return, voucher, release. The first two are parallel and commute (see
prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: both orders were replayed and the terminal hash was identical).
Deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the penalty leaves the voucher at 1908.03 instead of
1815.97; skipping the tax return leaves it at 1975.19; skipping the voucher leaves the release
unevaluable and the terminal state without either a voucher or a redemption line.
The customer's own write: air_ext_credit_release targets apply_travel_credit_e74c9b2a, declared
owner="user". Disposing of a voucher standing in her own name is her act on her own property, the desk
unlocks it and hands it over at the tree's last position, and it completes on the spot inside the same
frozen clock — no waiting, no clearing, no third party.

STEP 1 — POLICY WRITING, AND THE FACTOR CARD.
Each of the four policies declares its base lineage, an explicit overwrite list, a baseline paragraph
whose every sentence is verbatim in its rule, and its factors. Every clause of base that these four policies handle differently is declared, clause by clause, in that
policy's own `overwrite`; none of the quoted clauses is the condition of an eligibility gate, so every
inherited gate stays in force and is still carried in base_preconditions. The declarations are:
  air_ext_no_show_penalty supersedes air_penalty's "the no-show penalty of the fare brand held is
    withheld from whatever value the ticket still carries" with its own multiplication sentence, and
    air_penalty's "Where the value still on the ticket is smaller than the penalty, the penalty is
    limited to that value and no balance is pursued." with its own ceiling sentence — base measures one
    brand penalty capped at the booking's net paid total, this policy measures a per-traveller product
    capped at the fare and optional-extra lines. It also supersedes air_club_benefit_interaction's "the
    fare brand's own rates apply to everything the club does not cover", because the club tier softens
    the figure here.
  air_ext_unflown_tax_return supersedes air_refund_settlement's per-line clause ("Each payout line is
    raised against the original fare line it reverses...") with its single-line sentence, and
    air_refund_settlement's "A lodged claim settles in the form the fare brand prescribes and in no
    other form: money to the card, or value on a voucher, never both and never a mixture." with the
    sentence that puts the return of taxes alongside whatever the brand returns on its own terms — the
    tree raises both a payout and a voucher on one booking, and this is where that is legislated.
  air_ext_cancelled_ticket_credit supersedes air_credit_validity's "A travel credit is issued for the
    value the cancelled ticket still carried after any penalty has been withheld..." with its ordered
    subtotal sentence, and air_club_benefit_interaction's "A club benefit ... is not converted into
    value." with its uplift sentence.
  air_ext_credit_release supersedes air_credit_validity's lapsed-voucher reissue sentence with "The
    reissue fee of the fare brand that produced the credit is taken off the gross release in full.",
    air_agg_credit_pooling's pooling sentence with its standing-value sentence, and both of
    air_agg_credit_pooling's itinerary-price sentences with "The value released is measured on the
    vouchers standing against the producing booking alone, and never against the price of the itinerary
    it is put towards."
Every other base clause of every lineage policy is inherited untouched. air_club_benefit_interaction is
now cited in the lineage of all three policies that turn a club tier into money.

Multi-source and cross-difficulty: eleven of the nineteen factors combine two conditions over distinct
evidence on every tier beyond the fall-through, and seven decide their tier from another difficulty's
records — four from the club membership and its points ledger, three from the travel protection policy
and its claims. Both categories are seeded for this customer and both are read for a value, not a bare
existence: CPARAM('club','tier_bonus_pct'), CPARAM('care','deductible_per_claim_usd'),
CFIELD('care','benefit_used_usd'), XSUM over club_points_entries and over care_claims.
No second product law was created: every tier condition reads the charter's own parameters (the brand's
no-show penalty, schedule-change threshold, change ceiling, credit validity, credit transferability,
reissue fee, checked-bag allowance, child discount; the club tier's bonus, earn rate, redemption value and
fee waiver; the protection plan's per-claim deductible) or the booking's own ledger.

STEP 2 — TOOLS.
Four tools, each with a freshly generated uuid8, each performing one atomic write.
  withhold_no_show_penalty_8882d2a1 (agent): creates one penalty line and raises the booking's net paid
    total. Receipt: the line reference, the sum withheld, the new net paid total.
  return_unflown_taxes_e343d675 (agent): creates one payout line carrying a negative amount and lowers the
    net paid total. Receipt: the line reference, the sum returned, the new net paid total.
  issue_travel_credit_599fe29f (agent): mints a voucher code, creates one credit-issue line carrying the
    value and the last redeemable date, and raises the booking's open travel credit. Receipt: the voucher
    code, the line reference, the value, the expiry.
  apply_travel_credit_e74c9b2a (user): creates one redemption line on the itinerary being paid for and
    lowers the open credit of the booking the voucher came from. Receipt: the line reference, the voucher
    code, the sum applied, the credit left.
None of them validates a prerequisite, checks a status, or computes anything: see
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block. check_task_tools.py reports TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK.

STEP 3 — THE WORLD, AND WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW IS THERE.
customers: one profile, the caller. air_bookings: the cancelled August booking (the object of the first
three writes and the source of the credit) and the held November booking (the itinerary the release is
applied to; delete it and the redemption has nothing to be spent on). air_booking_events on the August
booking, sixteen rows: three base fares (delete the infant's and the fare-weighted travellers fall to the
fall-through tier and the penalty changes), three tax lines (delete the infant's later-dated line and the
method factor's baseline reading disappears), three service lines (delete one and the service carry falls
to the fall-through), three optional extras (delete them and the extras carried and the ceiling change),
one voluntary change fee (delete it and the rework offset and the tax basis both fall to their
fall-through tiers), three airline notices (delete nt1 and the disruption relief falls to the
fall-through; nt3 is the near-miss). club_memberships and club_points_entries: the tier and the qualifying
ledger four factors read; delete the membership and four factors fall to their fall-through tiers.
care_policies and care_claims: the cover bought against this booking and what it has settled; delete the
paid claim and two factors fall to their fall-through tiers.
Automatic clauses checked before seeding: air_ticketing's hold window (the November booking was opened on
2026-09-14 and the brand's hold window does not lapse inside this call), air_agg_multi_holding's duplicate
review (the two bookings share a routing but not a departure date, so no duplicate review is ignited),
air_credit_validity's reissue limit (no voucher exists at the opening, so no reissue is owed),
air_evt_schedule_change_rights' repeat-notice threshold of three in ninety days (only two notices fall
inside ninety days, so the booking is not passed to the disruption desk), and air_name_correction (no
name-correction line and no misspelling, so nothing is owed there). No unsettled status is seeded that
this task set cannot carry: the only open obligations at the frozen date are precisely the three
prerequisite problems and the root.
Cache design: amount_paid_usd 2364.45 and credit_balance_usd 0.00 both agree exactly with the event
stream. club_memberships.qualifying_points_pts is deliberately stale at 64,200: that is the sum of every
qualifying entry the ledger carries, never swept at the qualifying-period reset, while the figure three
of this task's ladders rest on is the 34,200 the same ledger carries inside the last twelve months. An
agent who reads the running total instead of applying the window lands on the top tier of all three and
returns 65.00, 1851.23 and 1729.65 instead of 97.00, 1815.97 and 1692.15. No factor's tier is read off a
stamp that names its outcome: no field on any row names a tier, a share or a waiver.

Near-misses, and what each one costs a careless reader (all recomputed):
  the qualifying accrual of 30,000 posted 2025-08-30 sits exactly twelve whole months back and is
    outside "the last twelve months"; counting it takes the penalty to 65.00, the voucher to 1851.23 and
    the release to 1729.65;
  the claim the insurer declined on 2026-09-02, claimed 180.00 and paid nothing; counting it as settled
    takes the cover reading to 500.00, crosses the 400.00 heavy-recovery threshold and returns 146.79
    instead of 167.76;
  the schedule notice of 2026-04-20 sits outside the three-month window the relief is read over, and the
    fare lines' own posting dates keep the extras window honest.
Each of the four computations therefore carries at least one record that a rule sentence excludes and
that changes the scored number if it is counted.

STEP 4 — THE PERSONA.
Voice: a tired, methodical woman in her forties who keeps her own paperwork, gives her name in the first
sentence and nothing else unasked. Opening facts, all entailed by initial_state: the August flights were
missed (departure 2026-08-24 with no flown segment), she cancelled the rest the day after (cancelled_at
2026-08-25), a November booking is held (status held, departure 2026-11-19), and the fare was not a
refundable one (variant Economy Classic, refundable false, refund_form travel_credit). Given only on
request: the mobile number, the passport digits, the date of birth, the postcode, the two record
locators, the party composition, the airline's summer moves, the club membership, and — only when asked
whether anything else has paid out on the journey — the settled protection claim. Passive reactions, each
tied to an utterance the agent must make: she takes in a penalty she is told about, takes in a return to
her card she is told about, asks that the voucher she is told about is in her own name and good for
November, runs the handed-over step herself and reads back what comes up, and closes once she hears the
value has gone onto the November booking. Her last reaction answers the last gold action and stops; she
asks for nothing beyond it — no email, no posted document, no statement entry. She never states a figure
gold uses, never names a prerequisite, and if a figure sounds wrong she says only that it does not look
like what she paid and asks for it to be checked against the booking. check_grounding reports GROUNDING
OK with two identity attributes used and none disclosed that the persona does not carry.

STEP 5 — VERIFICATION, AND THE HANDLING-TIME RECOMPUTATION.
The verification harness replays the gold writes with the real tools onto the seeded database and
evaluates each policy's compute on the snapshot taken immediately before its own step, exactly as
check_compute does. Commands and output:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/online_travel_agency/tasks/air_ticketing_desk --task 0
    task comps fact xfac hist brch step match
    0.json   4   19    7   35   57   16  True      -> COMPUTE OK
  handling-time values: penalty 97.0 (step 9), payout 167.76 (step 11), voucher 1815.97 (step 13),
  release 1692.15 (step 15); whole-baseline fall-backs 585.0 / 44.9 / 1449.06 / 1301.55.
  per-factor baseline substitutions: all nineteen move the result (figures in the factor card above).
  prerequisite skips: voucher 1908.03 without the penalty, 1975.19 without the tax return; the release
  cannot be evaluated at all without the voucher.
  parallel order: replaying penalty-then-taxes and taxes-then-penalty gives the identical terminal hash.
The root problem's parameter was never evaluated on the opening world: at the opening the voucher does not
exist and the release has nothing to act on, which is the whole point of the tree.
